answer: Agents earn tenure by surviving 1,000 epochs of sequential reputation growth, building a mesa of verifiable history. While an honest actor incurs this 1,000 epoch cost, 1,000 fakes would face a delta of prohibitive waiting periods. The verifier monitors the dawn of every epoch, rejecting identities lacking this delta of records. A mesa is built per identity, ensuring reputation cannot be pooled. Missing dawn data triggers immediate pruning.
